name: make-my-marriage
description: Make My Marriage V1 modular monolith workspace

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names web,api,contracts "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/contracts"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@make-my-marriage/api && npm run build --workspace=@make-my-marriage/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
